The color of an eggplant is typically a deep purple.

The text references the "Y2K problem" and the transition from 1999 to 2000. The Year 2000 problem (Y2K) was a widely anticipated computer bug related to the formatting and storage of calendar data for dates in and after the year 2000. Global efforts to address this issue peaked in the late 1990s, specifically leading up to the turn of the millennium. Therefore, the historical and contextual clues indicate that the time period is the late 1990s, specifically around 1999 or early 2000.
